sections.Profile:
The Jolly Roger pinball machine, produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in December 1967, is an electro-mechanical game with a pirate and adventure theme. Designed by Norm Clark and featuring artwork by Christian Marche, it was notable for being the first four-player pinball machine to include an on/off switch beneath the cabinet, a feature that became standard in future machines.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1967
